chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from 'Umar ibn Udhaynah, from al-Fadl and Zurarah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Humran, that he asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
regarding the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime: 'Surely We revealed it in the Night of Qadr.'
He said: Yes, it is the Night of Qadr, and it is in every year in the month of Ramadan, in the last ten nights. The Quran was not revealed except in the Night of Qadr.

Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, says: 'In it is made distinct every precise matter.' He said: It is decreed in the Night of Qadr everything that will occur in that year until its like next year, from good or evil, or obedience or disobedience, or a newborn, or a lifespan, or provision.
So whatever is decreed in that night and decided, it is among the determined, and for Allah is the Will in it.
He said: I said to him: 'The Night of Qadr is better than a thousand months,' what did he mean by it?

He said: The righteous deed in it, from prayer and alms-tax and types of good, is better than the deed in a thousand months in which there is no Night of Qadr. And if it were not for what Allah multiplies for the believers, they would not have reached [that reward], but indeed Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, multiplies for them the good deeds.

key_terms.يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ: In it is made distinct every precise matter

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Night of Qadr in Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Night of Qadr occurs within the last ten nights of Ramadan, serving as the annual occasion when all decrees for the coming year—ranging from sustenance and lifespan to acts of obedience and sin—are divinely determined. This narration highlights the profound theological significance of this night, where the multiplication of rewards for righteous deeds like prayer and charity makes them superior to a thousand months of ordinary worship, emphasizing the certainty of God's will in what is decreed.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 11.  The narrator asked Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.),
“Allah says, ‘Surely We revealed it (Quran) on a blessed night’,so which is that blessed night?”
Imam (a.s.) replied, “It is the night of Qadr (power), which is one of the last ten nights of the month of Ramadan. The Holy Quran was revealed in the night  of  Qadr  only.

Allah,  the  Mighty  and  Sublime  says, ‘The  fate  of  everything  would  be  decided  by  the  Divine order in this night’. All the good and bad, obedience and disobedience, birth and death, earnings etc. are decided by the Will of Allah for the whole year in this night only.”
The narrator asked, “What is the meaning of verse: ‘The  grand night  is  better  than  a  thousand  months’?”

Imam  (a.s.) replied, “The reward of good deeds performed in this night is better than that of doing the same for a thousand months without the night of Qadr. If the Almighty Allah wouldn’t have  multiplied  the  reward  for  a  believer  they  wouldn’t have got it but He multiplies the reward for them.”
